name: Empress Jitō
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 2); Porter’s note gives the dates as: reigned 690–696.

poems.title: The spring has gone, the summer’s come
poems.author: Empress Jitō
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 2
poems.text:
The spring has gone, the summer’s come,
And I can just descry
The peak of Ama-no-kagu,
Where angels of the sky
Spread their white robes to dry.
